notes: Fixed TAM recommendations showing as duplicate cards in multi-account setups (follow-up to 5.6.3). Recommendation items have no serialNumber/id, so when two configured accounts point at overlapping Active IQ orgs, the exact same generic recommendation (e.g. ACTIVE_SUPPORT_CONTRACTS) came back from both accounts and was merged in as two separate entries with identical text and scores. _merge_account_results() now dedupes tamRecommendations by content (recommendation text + category + subCategory + rank + score) instead of by account+id like the other list fields. Also added a Download Recommendations (TXT) button to Section 12 of the Action Planner, matching the export already available on every other Fleet Analysis section.
